d: Sri Lanka—a country known as the 'Pearl of the Indian Ocean,' which gave the world its first female Prime Minister and holds evidence dating back to the era of the Ramayana. It is home to sacred Buddhist sites like the 'Temple of the Tooth Relic,' and a place where you can witness the majestic blue whale up close amidst the ocean waves. This is Sri Lanka—a destination you simply must know about. So, come along with us on a journey to Sri Lanka, right here on Infinity Stream.
